title: The braid group and other groups
note: Quart. J. Math. Oxford Ser. (2) 20(1) (1969), 235-254. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.1093/qmath/20.1.235) (2026-11-28). Introduces the positive braid monoid B_n^+, the fundamental half-twist element Delta, the lattice of simple divisors, and the canonical normal form solving the word and conjugacy problems in B_n.
